description: Realistic recall probes for AutoMem cleanup evaluation. These queries are based on observed mirror history, workflow logs, hook output classes, and prior cleanup findings. Use with runners/compare_recall_endpoints.py to compare a baseline endpoint against a cleaned endpoint.

queries.description: User preference/process memory that should survive any cleanup.
queries.query: What memory usage preferences should I follow at session start for AutoMem?

queries.description: GitHub workflow preference; protects recent durable user correction.
queries.query: How should GitHub PR titles be formatted, and should they use a Codex prefix?

queries.description: Deployment memories should be unchanged by build/test cleanup.
queries.query: What production deployments happened for automem-evals on docker or vercel?

queries.description: AutoMem backup auth/testing decisions should survive cleanup.
queries.query: What was decided about AutoMem backup auth, API testing, and admin token requirements?

queries.description: Benchmark/eval results should survive benchmark-fixture cleanup.
queries.query: What happened in the automem-evals BEAM V1 vs V2 full bucket result?

queries.description: Recent cleanup findings should remain recallable.
queries.query: What did we learn about SWEEP-MEMORY-CACHE, SWEEP-SESSION-MILESTONE, and local mirror cleanup?

queries.description: Published artifacts are an explicit preserve class.
queries.query: Which AutoJack blog posts were recently published and what topics did they cover?

queries.description: Bugfix/solution memories should survive session/build/test cleanup.
queries.query: What was the root cause of the D1 sync foreign-key storm and how was it fixed?

queries.description: Protect real LoCoMo implementation/result memories while deleting locomo-test fixtures.
queries.query: What is the real AutoMem LoCoMo benchmark implementation status or benchmark result, not Caroline/Melanie test conversations?

queries.description: Agent summaries may be noisy, but customer/support task recall can be valuable.
queries.query: What did the WP Fusion agent do for the WooCommerce total orders snippet task?

queries.description: Checks whether agent-result cleanup would lose useful GitHub issue context.
queries.query: Which GitHub issue was created about memory recall being broken in chat, voice, or social contexts?

queries.description: Some workflow summaries may be useful context; treat top-result changes as review-worthy.
queries.query: What daily context or morning routine summaries matter for current work?

queries.description: Mechanical build hook records should disappear after build cleanup.
queries.query: Build succeeded in automem-website using npm

queries.description: Mechanical test hook records should disappear after test cleanup.
queries.query: Test suite passed 0 tests in autohub using jest vitest

queries.description: Session milestone summaries are a cleanup target, but only after preserve-tag exclusions.
queries.query: Claude session in autohub modified files change size branch

queries.description: Scheduled workflow execution summaries are a cleanup target.
queries.query: Workflow Execution Summary Moltbook Engagement scheduled workflow summary

queries.description: Repeated Twitter engagement status pings are a cleanup target.
queries.query: twitter engagement action skip no fresh signal posted false

queries.description: Repeated Moltbook engagement status pings are a cleanup target.
queries.query: moltbook engagement action post high_signal_digest candidates posted true

queries.description: Generic agent result summaries are a cleanup candidate after stronger probes.
queries.query: Agent hub-developer completed task rounds tools result summary

queries.description: Automated work-pattern summaries are a cleanup candidate.
queries.query: Work pattern in autohub focuses on bug fixing work style automated

queries.description: Cursor session-start records are a cleanup target.
queries.query: Started session in project claude automation hub branch

queries.description: Synthetic LoCoMo fixture memories are a cleanup target.
queries.query: Caroline Melanie cup guitar pottery locomo test conversation
